# algizian_email_settings (Resource)

Email-code sign-in of a tenant. Creating it turns the `email` provider on; destroying it deletes the settings and the stored password and turns the provider off. Either send through your own SMTP server (`sender = "own"`, TLS or STARTTLS only) or through the Algizian sender (`sender = "platform"`, where offered, with caps).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algizian_email_settings" "myapp" {
  tenant       = algizian_tenant.myapp.slug
  sender       = "own"
  host         = "smtp.example.com"
  port         = 587
  security     = "starttls"
  username     = "mailer"
  password     = var.smtp_password
  from_address = "login@example.com"
  from_name    = "MyApp"
  template     = "graphic"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sender` (String) `own` or `platform`.
- `tenant` (String) Slug of the tenant.

### Optional

- `daily_cap` (Number) Mails per day, 1 to 10000.
- `from_address` (String) Sender address (own sender). With the platform sender it is assigned.
- `from_name` (String) Sender name; default is the tenant's display name.
- `host` (String) SMTP host (own sender).
- `monthly_cap` (Number) Platform sender only: mails per month (tenant tokens up to the platform default).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password (own sender). Write-only for the API; kept in the state.
- `port` (Number) 465 or 587 (own sender).
- `security` (String) `tls` (port 465) or `starttls` (port 587); never plain text.
- `template` (String) `minimal` or `graphic`.
- `username` (String) SMTP user (own sender).

### Read-Only

- `effective_daily_cap` (Number)
- `effective_monthly_cap` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ready` (Boolean) The settings are complete and email sign-in works.
- `status` (String) Result of the last test mail: `untested`, ...

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import algizian_email_settings.myapp k3x9q2a
```
